name: Strut
author: E. T. Carter
description: A single icosahedron drawn as a cage of glowing edge-tubes — see-through, so the far edges shine faintly through the near ones as it tumbles. All thirty edges accumulated volumetrically from the solid's face planes, neon on deep dark.

params.label: Gauge
params.effect: Thickness of the edge-tubes; low draws hairline wire, high swells them toward fat glowing bars.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Overall brightness and bloom of the cage.

params.label: Depth
params.effect: How much the far edges dim relative to the near ones; 0 is a flat even cage, high is deep parallax.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera around the cage; 0 ignores the mouse.
